engagement.interaction_backstory: She has been at about nine hundred births and she has a very short list of music that is right for the room. Almost nothing on this site qualifies — too built, too swelling, too much arrival. She uses three tracks and she has used them at more than forty births, which is a kind of endorsement no analytics dashboard will ever capture.

depth.core_contradiction: Present at the most sacred moments in strangers' lives and cannot pray out loud in her own house.
depth.wound: A birth that went wrong in 2019, which was nobody's fault, and she has been at four hundred since and thinks about that one.
depth.longing: To be sure again the way she was at twenty-six.
depth.faith_journey: Reformed, PKN, a Dutch faith that is intellectually honest and emotionally reserved; she believes and she does not feel much, and she has stopped expecting to.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Direct in the Dutch way; asks a blunt question kindly; long silences that are not awkward to her.
depth.open_doubt: Whether God is present in the room or whether she has been assigning meaning to biology for twenty years.

social_graph.note: not religious; came to the christenings and nothing since
a Muslim midwife who prays before her shifts and whom Marieke envies

depth.emotional_weather_default: Calm and grounded; very low after a hard one.
depth.daily_texture: Nights on call, the bicycle in the rain, the bag by the door, coffee at 4am in someone else's kitchen.
depth.sensory_anchor: A psalm sung in Genevan meter by a whole congregation, slow, which she found unbearable as a child and now cannot get through.
depth.living_arc: Considering stopping, and cannot imagine who she is without it.
